submittedInput.content: The voice sounded like my aunt and caller ID showed her usual saved name. She asked me to tell her my WhatsApp registration code because her phone was broken. I did not start a WhatsApp registration.

body.title: Keep account codes private
body.nextStep: Do not send your password or account verification code to another person.
body.reason: Sharing an account code or password can let someone access your account.
body.uncertainty: The sender’s identity and intentions have not been verified.

evidence.title: Caller identity is not verified
evidence.detail: No complete number was extracted and no authorised reported-number feed is connected. The supplied description can still be assessed for the action requested.

evidence.title: Protect WhatsApp account codes
evidence.detail: SPF warns that a compromised WhatsApp account can send requests appearing to come from a familiar person. Do not give another person the one-time password used to access your WhatsApp account. Source reviewed 2026-09-26; review expires 2026-10-26. This is reference guidance, not proof about this message.
